bio.text: Mara Gorman represents the 23rd District in the Delaware House of Representatives, which includes the western and northern side of Newark.
Gorman served as a volunteer Moms Demand Action chapter lead and as Public Affairs Manager for Planned Parenthood of Delaware.
Gorman holds a BA in political science and French from Middlebury College and an MFA in creative nonfiction from Pennsylvania State University.
